_readme: The Artificer's pixel-art style guide, machine-readable (#1673, epic #1672). The PixelLab icon pass (#1674) reads this with art-briefs.json: every request gets these sizes, this palette, this outline and light, and the reference icons as style images. The prose version is docs/art-pipeline.md. Palette: extracted from 36 of the old Homestead item icons that fit the Artificer's hand-made, stone-age-and-scout-kit look (k-means, 32 colours), so new icons sit beside the kept ones.

eraLooks.use: the interface frame's nine looks (three eras of three steps: scout and cartographer, steampunk, rune tech), their rules and touchstones (#1718, epic #1717). Not the item art: icons keep this file's style in every era. Palettes come later (#1693).

icon.use: tier 0: every material, item, tool and recipe result; also the static frame of an action icon

card.use: tier 1: the inspect card, made first; the item's icon is then redrawn to match it

actionIcon.use: an animated loop per camp action (#1678); frame 0 is the idle frame and the action's static icon

portrait.use: a JRPG talking bust for people encounters (#1679), drawn from the person's tier-2 concept art

view: front, a slight three-quarter tilt for objects with depth

pixellab.promptSuffix: pixel art RPG inventory icon, transparent background
